title: Process Definition Document (PDD)
description: The contract for a configurable business process. One generic engine interprets any document that conforms to this schema. Invoice approval is one example.

process_key.description: Stable business identity of the process, e.g. 'invoice_approval'.

version.description: Definition version. In-flight transactions stay pinned to the version they started on.

roles.description: Maps logical role names used inside the PDD to real Keycloak realm roles.

config.description: Tunable values referenced by node conditions (thresholds, quorum, SLA, etc.). Editable without changing the graph.

data_schema.description: The business fields a transaction of this process carries. Drives the dynamic Start form in the UI and validation. Stored in transaction.data_snapshot (JSONB) — no per-process table.

extraction.description: Optional document-extraction spec for an 'automated' extract node: which fields to pull and from what source.

notifications.description: Rules mapping an event to a recipient and a message template. Replaces hardcoded recipient logic.

to_role.description: Logical role (key of the roles map) to notify.

nodes.description: The process graph. Exactly one 'start' and at least one 'end'.

next.description: Single successor node id (for linear nodes).

action.description: For 'automated' nodes: the registered action to run, e.g. 'extract_fields', 'post_to_erp'.

outcome.description: For 'end' nodes: terminal outcome recorded on the transaction, e.g. 'approved'.

assignment.description: For 'human_task': who the task goes to.

role.description: Logical role name (key of the roles map).

form_schema.description: For 'human_task': the fields the UI renders for the human to fill.

routes.description: For 'llm_decision': the bounded set of outcomes the model may choose among (hard rail).

edges.description: Successor mapping. Either an object {EDGE_NAME: node_id} (for llm_decision) or a list of {when, to} (for conditional branches).
